verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a broad eSignature REST API with official SDKs ('send, sign, and approve documents'), OpenAPI specifications on GitHub used to generate its client libraries, and an official MCP server for querying agreements and triggering workflow actions. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates parity with the UI, and many UI-centric features (CLM drag-and-drop process design, web-forms builder, AI-assisted review in Word) have no evidenced API equivalent. One community user also described the API as 'an afterthought' compared to the product itself. missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity claim or coverage documentation, API evidence for CLM/web-forms/AI-review features, independent corroboration of full coverage.
